        How to Play

        WASD
        Walk
        Mouse
        Look around
        Left Click
        Break blocks (hold), attack
        Right Click
        Place blocks; use tables, furnaces, chests, doors and beds; talk to villagers; ride boats, horses and minecarts
        Hold Right
        Eat or drink, draw a bow, raise a shield
        Space
        Jump (double-tap to fly in Creative)
        Shift
        Sneak, fly down
        Ctrl
        Sprint (or double-tap forwards); under water, swim
        1–9 Wheel
        Choose a hotbar slot
        E
        Inventory and crafting
        Q
        Drop the held item
        Middle Click
        Pick the block you look at
        T /
        Chat and commands (try /help)
        Esc
        Game menu (Open to Friends is in there)
        F1
        Hide the HUD (for screenshots)
        F3
        Debug info
        F5
        See yourself from behind or in front

        Change any of these keys in Options, under Key Binds.

        Punch a tree for logs and turn them into planks in your inventory's crafting grid. Four planks make a crafting table: right-click it for the full 3×3 grid, where a wooden pickaxe gets you mining. The green book lists every recipe and lays it out for you.

        Furnaces smelt ores and cook meat: the item goes on top, fuel below. Weapons need a moment between swings (the bar under the crosshair), so time your hits. You heal while your food bar is nearly full.

        Settlements come in every size, from camps in the woods to walled towns and kingdoms with a castle and a king. Go in through a gate and right-click the people there to talk and trade: they buy and sell for gold coins. /locate kingdom (or camp, hamlet, village, town) points the way. Sleep in a bed to make it your spawn point.

        Each animal lives where it belongs: deer, bears and boar in the woods, zebras, giraffes and elephants on the savanna, pandas and tigers in the jungle, polar bears and penguins in the snow. In Creative, the Spawn Eggs tab (or /summon tiger) brings out any creature you like.

        To play with friends, open a world, press Esc and choose Open to Friends. On claude.ai, people you've shared this page with see your world under Multiplayer; anywhere else, give them the join code.

        On a touch screen the left stick walks, dragging looks around, a tap places and holding breaks.

        Textures: the Pixel Perfection resource pack by XSSheep and its community, with Mineclonia's for the newest blocks (CC BY-SA 4.0). Sounds: public-domain recordings by Kenney and Freesound contributors.
